name: nodemap-minimal
notes: The plain-ML degeneration of the node-map grammar (docs/24): no clock -> single pass; no capital -> no stat_test requirement; random split with train+val == 1.0 -> no test split; baseline wired -> relative scoring. Every `uses` is an import reference, so this document runs against the bare toolkit with zero registrations: python -m dskit.pipeline run examples/pipeline/nodemap-minimal.json --asof 2026-01-01

dataset.notes: role 'data' (declared by the class): the deterministic synthetic market

market.notes: role 'signal': the market's own price — the baseline
